title: CreativeBrief
description: Output of the Creative Brief Parser: a structured extraction of a raw, free-text user idea. This is the AI Director pipeline's first stage - it exists so every later stage (Story Planner, Scene Generator, ...) reasons over consistent structured fields instead of re-parsing free text independently.

key_message.description: The single most important takeaway the video must communicate.

must_include.description: Explicit elements the brief requires (e.g. a product, a tagline, a specific scene).

must_avoid.description: Explicit exclusions, feeding into the eventual negative_prompt_global.

inferred_target_duration_sec.description: Only set if the parser inferred a duration the raw idea implied but ProjectBrief did not explicitly set.

ambiguities.description: Things the parser had to assume because the raw idea under-specified them - surfaced so a human can clarify before expensive stages run, or so the Story Planner knows which assumptions are soft.
